observed_failure: A masked taxel cluster makes a pretrained edge-contact feature appear reliable until the grasp rolls.
proposed_status: detected late by v5; oracle still better
lesson: Require hardware sensor-health logs and dropout-robust tactile encoders.

observed_failure: Two materials share a high-frequency texture signature but have opposite slip thresholds.
proposed_status: v5 lowers harm but keeps residual false confidence
lesson: Validate aliasing with real material libraries.

observed_failure: A shear spike arrives after the control decision, so the source feature is temporally misaligned.
proposed_status: latency compensation helps but cannot remove all delay
lesson: Measure sensor-to-actuator timing on hardware.

observed_failure: A conservative gate rejects a useful pretrained channel during benign clean transfer.
proposed_status: v5 retention term reduces but does not eliminate this error
lesson: Tune clean-transfer retention with real validation contacts.

observed_failure: A contact patch shape has no source-domain analogue and confuses channel criticality.
proposed_status: v5 abstains more often
lesson: Add geometry-conditioned tactile augmentation.

observed_failure: A small slip error causes irreversible drop damage while similar classification errors are benign.
proposed_status: damage-asymmetry term improves fixed-risk utility
lesson: Report damage-weighted success, not raw success alone.

observed_failure: Shear appears before normal-force change and is missed by scalar uncertainty gates.
proposed_status: action-critical mask improves detection
lesson: Use transient tactile features in external validation.

observed_failure: Taxel bias correlates with hard tasks, making adaptation mistake damage for task difficulty.
proposed_status: health model partially disentangles the effect
lesson: Collect calibration sweeps separated from task labels.

observed_failure: Domain alignment erases a tactile feature that is predictive only in the target domain.
proposed_status: v5 retains action-critical target evidence
lesson: Compare against invariant-risk and target-only baselines.

observed_failure: Fast adaptation chases a drifting tactile channel and increases regret.
proposed_status: risk budget rejects some harmful adapted states
lesson: Freeze adaptation windows before final evaluation.

observed_failure: Oracle feature selection remains above v5 when all shift types co-occur.
proposed_status: reported as residual headroom
lesson: Do not claim solved negative transfer.

observed_failure: High uncertainty methods spend queries on non-action-critical tactile features.
proposed_status: v5 lowers query cost relative to uncertainty gates
lesson: Evaluate under fixed query budgets.

observed_failure: Soft objects appear safe at low force but fail after accumulated deformation.
proposed_status: v5 helps through damage asymmetry
lesson: Add deformation-state memory.

observed_failure: Thin object edges mimic texture changes and trigger wrong transfer decisions.
proposed_status: v5 has fewer but nonzero false rejections
lesson: Use geometry-aware tactile representations.

observed_failure: Snap-fit success requires force transients that look harmful under source data.
proposed_status: v5 preserves more clean success than conformal risk
lesson: Separate necessary force from damaging force.

observed_failure: A fragile container shifts grip dynamics after handoff, increasing unseen damage.
proposed_status: v5 reduces damage but not enough for submission claim
lesson: Require robot handoff rollouts and videos.

observed_failure: Tactile servoing lags a surface ridge and accumulates path error.
proposed_status: latency term improves regret
lesson: Validate timing in closed-loop servo control.

observed_failure: Masked pretraining encodes object identity rather than contact mechanics.
proposed_status: v5 beats masked pretraining under heldout object
lesson: Audit representation shortcuts.

observed_failure: Contrastive positives preserve source material identity, harming target compliance.
proposed_status: v5 uses mismatch estimate to reject the channel
lesson: Use target-aware positive-pair construction.

observed_failure: Conformal risk control rejects too many beneficial transfers in clean settings.
proposed_status: v5 improves retention but keeps risk coverage finite
lesson: Report clean-transfer retention alongside safety.

observed_failure: Ensemble members agree on the same wrong tactile alias.
proposed_status: v5 action-critical mismatch catches more aliases
lesson: Stress-test epistemic and aleatoric failure separately.

observed_failure: A no-tactile policy can be safer than bad tactile transfer under severe latency.
proposed_status: reported as a boundary case
lesson: Always include no-tactile and scratch baselines.

observed_failure: Scratch tactile learning avoids source harm but lacks target data efficiency.
proposed_status: v5 keeps transfer benefit with lower harm
lesson: Report data/query cost explicitly.

observed_failure: The audit is deterministic and local but has no trained tactile policy checkpoint.
proposed_status: scope gate fails honestly
lesson: Release trained checkpoints and hardware logs before submission.
